steps.code:
# Parse the old songs file to extract song titles and artists.
import re

content = file_result['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence? but title may contain " by "? assume first " by " separates)
        # Use rsplit to get last " by "? Actually format is "Title by Artist(s)" so split on " by " once from right.
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artists_str = line.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append((title.strip(), artists))
        else:
            # fallback: treat whole as title
            old_songs.append((line.strip(), []))
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for t, a in old_songs:
    print(t, '|', a)
